# An action's identifier rests on more than the template's source, and a run
# that reused a verdict across a change to any of it would report a kill it
# never earned. This checks the two inputs no source edit touches.
#
# First the type. Name goes from string to a named string type. Not one byte
# of the template changes, the dot type is still server.Page, and the mutant
# substituted is still the same text -- only the type resolved for the action
# is different. The verdict must be tried again.
#
# Then the seed. Same source, same types as the run before it, only the drawn
# values differ. Those values are what the tests were measured against, so the
# earlier verdict does not answer for them either.
#
# Neither run reports anything reused. That is the whole assertion: a reused
# verdict here would be one carried across a change that could have flipped it.
#
# The file itself is pinned too. It is committed and reviewed, so its shape is
# part of the interface: the engine field is what makes an improvement to the
# mutation engine recalculate rather than trust an older one's answers, and the
# suite record is what lets a later run tell an added test from an edited one.

muxt test-template-mutations --seed 1
cmp stdout want-first.txt
cmp testdata/template-mutations.json want-state.txt

cp type-changed.txt template.go
muxt test-template-mutations --seed 1
cmp stdout want-first.txt

muxt test-template-mutations --seed 2
cmp stdout want-seed-2.txt

-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- templates.gohtml --
{{define "greeting"}}Hello, {{.Name}}!{{end}}
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"io"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateFiles embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateFiles, "*.gohtml"))

type Page struct {
	Name string
}

func Greet(w io.Writer, page Page) error {
	return templates.ExecuteTemplate(w, "greeting", page)
}
-- type-changed.txt --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"io"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateFiles embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateFiles, "*.gohtml"))

type Name string

type Page struct {
	Name Name
}

func Greet(w io.Writer, page Page) error {
	return templates.ExecuteTemplate(w, "greeting", page)
}
-- render_test.go --
package server

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestGreet(t *testing.T) {
	var buf strings.Builder
	if err := Greet(&buf, Page{Name: "World"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got, want := buf.String(), "Hello, World!"; got != want {
		t.Errorf("greeting = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
}
-- want-first.txt --
1 mutant across 1 template (complexity 1, seed 1)
baseline ok

1 mutant, 1 killed, 0 missed, 0 skipped
